name: Summit AZ - Leak Detection City Pages
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-26

# Summary
Three water leak detection city page rewrites from the low-hanging-fruit plan (Sep 26). Each was a near-copy of a sibling city page. Same Elementor layout, text only, with a self-check that no sentences are shared with the other drafts. Applied live Sep 25 to 26 per the handoff.

# Pages
| City | ID | Draft file | Before | Keywords |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Apache Junction | 10268 | `Summit-AZ-Leak-Detection-Apache-Junction-Draft-2026-09-26.md` | 73% same as Gilbert; top query "slab leak repair apache junction" but no slab section | water leak detection in Apache Junction (kept, KD 75 exception), slab leak repair (2,400 / 24) with its own H2 linking up to /slab-leaks/ |
| Queen Creek | 10274 | `Summit-AZ-Leak-Detection-Queen-Creek-Draft-2026-09-26.md` | 83% same as Scottsdale | water leak detection in Queen Creek, underground water leak detection (1,600 / 18), leak detection plumber (720 / 9) |
| San Tan Valley | 10275 | `Summit-AZ-Leak-Detection-San-Tan-Valley-Draft-2026-09-26.md` | 97% same as Gilbert | water leak detection in San Tan Valley, leak detection services (2,900 / 3), leak detection (12,100 / 9) |

# Sources
- Apache Junction Water District, City of Apache Junction and Arizona Water Company.
- Town of Queen Creek leak check guide, water FAQ and provider page.
- EPCOR, EPA and Pinal County for San Tan Valley.

# Decisions and status
- The "Emergency Service" and "Fast Response" icon boxes were left in place pending Kim's decision.
- Titles drop the brand where the full suffix would exceed 60 characters (site convention: full brand or none).
- Early check Oct 5: Queen Creek target terms gained 7 to 12 positions ("leak detection queen creek" 24.3 to 12.4); Apache Junction "slab leak repair apache junction" 10.4 to 8.0.
- Open: slab leak searches split between /slab-leaks/ and the city pages (Keyword Targeting Audit, Conflicts row 6). Near-duplicate pair leak detection Gilbert vs STV was flagged in the handoff.
